title: Kartavya
why: Saif Ali Khan as a small-town cop torn between his duty and his family. A slow-burn crime drama that stays gripping.

title: Gone Girl
why: The ultimate twisty thriller. The mid-movie reveal still lives in my head.

title: The Girl on the Train
why: An unreliable narrator, so you keep second-guessing everything until the very end.

title: The Housemaid
why: A maid takes a job with a seemingly perfect family, and nothing in that house is what it seems. Super addictive.

title: The Innocent
why: A Spanish Harlan Coben adaptation where one past mistake keeps pulling a man back into danger. Dark, layered and full of twists.

title: Fool Me Once
why: A widow spots her murdered husband on a nanny cam, and it only gets wilder from there. Peak Harlan Coben binge material.

title: I Will Find You
why: Sooo sooo good. A dad breaks out of prison to find the son everyone thinks is dead. Tense, twisty, emotional and impossible to stop watching.

title: Stay Close
why: Gripping from the first episode and keeps you on the edge of your seat. I did not see that ending coming.
